pillar: 8 — Outbound (writing; sending stays with the marketer)
intents: Write a cold email sequence for this list
What do I send to these prospects?
Write LinkedIn connection notes and messages for these leads
First lines for my prospects, from their buying signals
How do I reply to this prospect? / Handle this objection
Win back business accounts that churned
Why is nobody replying to my outreach?
reads: Brand Brain when brain_* tools are listed: brain_map first (core rules, never-list, waiting items, chapters 14, 22, 23, products), brain_search for lessons and signed-off claims; fallback brand_read + knowledge_search
workspace research/audience/ — newest <date>-<list>/list.csv (rows, segments, signals, hooks, region flags), fit-definition.md, buyer-groups.md, voc-bank.md, ledger.csv, lessons/ (research-audience)
workspace outreach/ — earlier packs, results and lessons (this playbook)
claims via claims-gate (its scoped sign-off, or earlier records by learn-my-brand, unreleased) — every proof line
brand brain: summary, kit, products with prices, learnings incl. [outreach …] rules (server research and the app, save-learning; learn-my-brand, unreleased)
the sender's voice card brand/voices/<handle>.md if one exists (voice-card, read only)
human-supplied: replies, campaign stats, churned-account list (win-back), the sending tool's import format
run records runs/write-outreach/outreach/<pack-slug>/… (run-memory) and the ledger for per-segment and per-opener outcomes
writes: local gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<date>-outreach.md and workspace outreach/<date>-<slug>/pack.md → 'Outreach pack — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history) via write-report and save-to-brain — read by the marketer and the next run
local gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<date>-outreach-send.csv and workspace outreach/<date>-<slug>/send.csv (never imported to the brain — people's data) — read by the marketer's sending tool
workspace outreach/<date>-<slug>/results.md → 'Outreach results — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history) — read by the next pack and research-audience
research/audience/ledger.csv statuses and research/audience/lessons/<date>.md via outcomes-ledger (entity: person) — read by research-audience and the next pack
run records runs/write-outreach/outreach/<pack-slug>/<date>.md (keep-history) via run-memory — counts, rates and links only; ledger opener_id and sequence_id columns at delivery
